label: INTERNAL / UNVALIDATED. In-house engineering mapping, not externally validated, not domain-reviewed, no sign-off. Mapped does not mean implemented, golden-tested or approved; unsupported entries still fail closed and imply no effect.

coverage_levels.mapped: Engineering has recorded scope, engines, facts, guardrail, timing and conflicts.
coverage_levels.implemented: Runtime level: LIMITED_COMPONENT (v2.6 converter), LIMITED_PREVIEW / BLOCKED_PREVIEW (v2.7), or NOT_IMPLEMENTED_FAIL_CLOSED.
coverage_levels.golden_tested: Independent golden reference for the full event semantics. None exist.
coverage_levels.domain_approved: Qualified external domain review. None exist.

entries.semantic_scope: Shift planned stop-work age later; extend wages/CPF accrual by employment type
entries.guardrail: No guarantee of employment continuation
entries.timing_rule: New retirement age must exceed the approved age; change applies from the month after the original stop-work month.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse without new_retirement_age and an existing approved retirement age.
entries.rationale: Existing RETIREMENT_GOAL_ONLY converter moves the stop-work age only; full mapping adds F03/F06 CPF accrual, which is not implemented, so coverage stays a limited component.

entries.semantic_scope: Insert dated new job stream and correct contribution scheme; leave CPF LIFE payments untouched absent official change
entries.guardrail: Do not assume rehiring, salary or pension suspension
entries.timing_rule: Job stream starts on the verified effective_date (>= as_of) and only after the household member has stopped work.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse (fail closed) until every required fact is user-supplied or member-transcribed from an official source; unknown is never zero.
entries.rationale: Needs a new dated income stream plus employee/SEP/platform CPF recalculation (F03-F05); no safe component subset exists, so it stays fail-closed.

entries.semantic_scope: Model separate households after documented separation dates and agreed financial obligations only
entries.guardrail: Block property division, maintenance, CPF or custody assumptions without actual terms
entries.timing_rule: Effects start only from a documented separation/settlement date; nothing is back-dated.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Block: never infer property division, maintenance, CPF or custody without actual terms.
entries.rationale: Priority 5A item whose v2.7 entry deliberately always blocks; mapping to F01/F12/F18 records the facts a future engine needs without implying any effect.

entries.semantic_scope: On verified death event stop deceased income; introduce only confirmed survivors benefits, claims and estate receipts
entries.guardrail: Do not assume inheritance/insurance payouts, spouse CPF rights
entries.timing_rule: Applies from a verified date of death; survivor receipts start only on confirmed payment dates.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Block: do not assume insurance, estate or survivor CPF payments.
entries.rationale: Requires verified survivor income, claims and estate data across F07/F11/F18; nothing can be computed from defaults, so fail-closed.

entries.semantic_scope: Introduce dated newborn/dependant recurring and one-time costs, medical and education
entries.guardrail: Benefits and grants conditional until confirmed
entries.timing_rule: start_year >= as_of year; duration_years 1-50; cost applies monthly within that window.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse without a positive user-supplied extra_monthly.
entries.rationale: Cost-only recurring component already exists; benefits/grants (F17) stay excluded from baseline per D12, so it remains a limited component.

entries.semantic_scope: Add timed adult-child support; distinguish loan vs grant and one-time vs recurring
entries.guardrail: Avoid implied permanent support or double counting
entries.timing_rule: start_year >= as_of year; duration_years 1-50; one-time vs recurring must be chosen explicitly.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse without a positive user-supplied extra_monthly.
entries.rationale: Recurring-cost component covers cash support; incompatible with S044 for the same transfer to avoid double counting (D16).

entries.semantic_scope: Update property fair value and secured-equity estimate, leave cash and loan principal unchanged
entries.guardrail: Loss of net worth is not immediate cash outflow
entries.timing_rule: Revaluation dated at a user-supplied valuation date; no cash flow is created.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse (fail closed) until every required fact is user-supplied or member-transcribed from an official source; unknown is never zero.
entries.rationale: A net-worth/LTV change, not a cash outflow; the current projection has no per-property equity ledger (F08), so it fails closed.

entries.semantic_scope: Sale proceeds less settlement/fees/CPF refund; separate OA/RA credits; replacement purchase, duties, bridge, new loan flows
entries.guardrail: CPF refunds are not available cash; eligibility and timing must be confirmed
entries.timing_rule: Sale completion date and replacement purchase date must both be supplied; CPF refund is credited at completion, not as spendable cash.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse without member-transcribed official CPF property refund; show deficit rather than affordability when financing is needed (D11).
entries.rationale: Priority 5A item with a v2.7 cash-arithmetic preview that may not post to the projection; the full F08/F06 waterfall is not implemented.

entries.semantic_scope: Use official scheme eligibility and quote, including lease, RA and proceeds, then model dated receipts
entries.guardrail: No estimated HDB Lease Buyback entitlement
entries.timing_rule: Receipts dated from an official scheme quote; lease and RA effects follow the quoted dates only.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse (fail closed) until every required fact is user-supplied or member-transcribed from an official source; unknown is never zero.
entries.rationale: Depends on official HDB eligibility and quote; no estimate is permitted, so it fails closed.

entries.semantic_scope: Apply real-return sensitivity to explicit nominal return and inflation paths per asset
entries.guardrail: Do not subtract inflation twice
entries.timing_rule: Explicit per-year nominal return and inflation paths; each year applied once.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse (fail closed) until every required fact is user-supplied or member-transcribed from an official source; unknown is never zero.
entries.rationale: Needs per-asset return and inflation paths (F10); a global override would double-subtract inflation alongside S028, so it fails closed.

entries.semantic_scope: Apply ordered path of early losses and withdrawals; recompute end capital and reserve
entries.guardrail: Sequence of returns matters, not just average return
entries.timing_rule: Ordered, dated return path applied before/after each withdrawal consistently.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse (fail closed) until every required fact is user-supplied or member-transcribed from an official source; unknown is never zero.
entries.rationale: Sequence-of-returns risk requires a time-indexed portfolio path (F10/F14) that does not exist yet; fail-closed.

entries.semantic_scope: Apply shock to named concentrated holding and denominator of total portfolio
entries.guardrail: Not a shock to entire investments
entries.timing_rule: Shock dated to a single holding at a user-supplied date.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse (fail closed) until every required fact is user-supplied or member-transcribed from an official source; unknown is never zero.
entries.rationale: Needs holding-level portfolio detail; reusing market_crash would wrongly shock the whole portfolio, so it fails closed.

entries.semantic_scope: Move wage stop date earlier; recompute contributions and explicit liquidity bridge to official payout age
entries.guardrail: CPF LIFE start not moved earlier by early employment exit
entries.timing_rule: New retirement age must be below the approved age; CPF LIFE start age is not moved.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse without new_retirement_age and an existing approved retirement age.
entries.rationale: Existing converter moves the stop-work age only; liquidity bridge (F14) and CPF effects (F03/F06/F07) are not implemented, so limited component.

entries.semantic_scope: Compare separate member-provided official payout scenarios from 65/70 and bridging cash needs
entries.guardrail: No automatic best-age advice or generic uplift as personal quote
entries.timing_rule: Compare two member-transcribed official estimates dated with their as-of date; no break-even.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse unless estimate_source is a member-transcribed official CPF estimate (D-002).
entries.rationale: Priority 5A item with a v2.7 comparison-only preview; no actuarial or lifetime calculation, so limited preview.

entries.semantic_scope: Reallocate confirmed available cash/OA to RA under verified limits; revise payout only with new official member estimate
entries.guardrail: Do not award assumed tax relief or payout increase
entries.timing_rule: Top-up dated at transfer; payout change only from a new official member estimate.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse (fail closed) until every required fact is user-supplied or member-transcribed from an official source; unknown is never zero.
entries.rationale: Needs verified RA limits and account transfers on the F06 ledger plus a fresh F07 estimate; fail-closed.

entries.semantic_scope: Calculate dated cash bridge until actual member-provided payout start; report reserve exhaustion
entries.guardrail: Cannot withdraw restricted CPF to plug deficit
entries.timing_rule: Bridge runs from stop-work date to the member-provided official payout start date.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse (fail closed) until every required fact is user-supplied or member-transcribed from an official source; unknown is never zero.
entries.rationale: Needs dated cash drawdown and reserve logic (F14, D09); restricted CPF can never fill the gap, so fail-closed until built.

entries.semantic_scope: Suspend contributor-specific CPF postings for verified months; recompute full cash/payroll interactions
entries.guardrail: Never assume CPF contributions continue after income stops
entries.timing_rule: Suspends contributions only for the verified months of the affected income stream.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse (fail closed) until every required fact is user-supplied or member-transcribed from an official source; unknown is never zero.
entries.rationale: Needs contributor-specific CPF posting and allocation (F03-F06); never assume contributions continue, so fail-closed.

entries.semantic_scope: Separate disabled-person spending, reduced wages and confirmed benefits into distinct dated streams
entries.guardrail: Do not infer disability-benefit eligibility
entries.timing_rule: start_year >= as_of year; duration_years 1-50; cost applies monthly within that window.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse without a positive user-supplied extra_monthly.
entries.rationale: Cost component exists; income disruption (F02) and benefits (F11/F17) are separate and unimplemented; overlapping S036 care cost would double count.

entries.semantic_scope: Combine location-specific cost, FX, foreign pensions, residency/tax status and healthcare
entries.guardrail: Block jurisdiction-specific unsupported rules
entries.timing_rule: Relocation dated from a user-supplied move date; jurisdiction rules apply only from then.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Block jurisdiction-specific rules that are not sourced (D13).
entries.rationale: Cross-border tax, healthcare, residency and FX (F09/F13/F15) are unsupported, so fail-closed.

entries.semantic_scope: Revalue each foreign-currency asset, liability and recurring receipt using dated FX path
entries.guardrail: Do not treat unrealised FX change as cash realised
entries.timing_rule: Each foreign exposure revalued on a dated FX path; unrealised changes are not cash.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse (fail closed) until every required fact is user-supplied or member-transcribed from an official source; unknown is never zero.
entries.rationale: Needs explicit currency amounts and dated FX rates (F15); fail-closed.

entries.semantic_scope: End offshore and start onshore incomes/costs with relocation expenses and tax residency changes
entries.guardrail: Residency rights and tax effects must be documented
entries.timing_rule: Offshore streams end and onshore streams start on a documented return date.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Block until residency and tax effects are documented (D13).
entries.rationale: Cross-border law and verified flows required; fail-closed.

entries.semantic_scope: Enter verified foreign pension gross/net and indexation rules with FX and withholding
entries.guardrail: No unverified foreign pension entitlement
entries.timing_rule: Change applies from the pension provider's documented effective date.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Block: no unverified foreign pension entitlement (D13).
entries.rationale: Needs verified foreign pension terms with FX and withholding (F13/F15); fail-closed.

entries.semantic_scope: Post confirmed net inheritance receipt after probate, costs and actual ownership transfer
entries.guardrail: Pending estate is not available cash
entries.timing_rule: Posted once in start_year after probate and actual transfer; pending estate is not cash.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse without a positive confirmed net_received_once; excluded from baseline (D12).
entries.rationale: Net cash receipt component exists; entitlement, probate and tax are out of scope, so limited component.

entries.semantic_scope: Book verified sale proceeds after debt/fees and stop business earnings/equity upon closing
entries.guardrail: Avoid double-counting business value and sale proceeds
entries.timing_rule: Proceeds booked at verified completion; business income and equity stop the same date.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse (fail closed) until every required fact is user-supplied or member-transcribed from an official source; unknown is never zero.
entries.rationale: Needs net proceeds, liabilities and earnings cessation (F02/F09/F18); avoid double counting value and proceeds, so fail-closed.

entries.semantic_scope: Reduce spendable liquid assets on dated cash gift, reflect other household only when ownership known
entries.guardrail: Do not gift restricted CPF balances
entries.timing_rule: Posted once in start_year from liquid assets; restricted CPF can never be gifted.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Refuse without a positive net_cash_gift_once.
entries.rationale: Cash gift outflow component exists; recipient-household effects only when ownership is known, so limited component.

entries.semantic_scope: Cease business revenue, write down business equity, include documented personal guarantees/liabilities
entries.guardrail: Do not automatically transfer company debt to individual
entries.timing_rule: Revenue stops at a documented closure date; personal exposure only for documented guarantees.
entries.missing_data_behaviour: Block: company debt is never automatically transferred to the individual.
entries.rationale: Liabilities, guarantees and income must be documented together (F02/F18); fail-closed.
